Notes.description:
This is a logbook of operations and general communication.

With new additions, please add: 

1. Date
2. Your name or initial with the new addition and names of anyone involved
3. Additional to-do items with the note.

Example:

11/11/25
1. Meeting with SCG personnel and candidate Last Name
     -fill out survey by 11/13/25
     -connect with host about food operations, H. will make contact by 11/12/25

Expenses Reimbursed.description:
Contact hosts, co-hosts, and SCG personnel if applicable for reimbursement.

The process of getting reimbursed is: 

Email compliance
Title: Date of event, First and Last Name, Reimbursement
Description/Body: Employer of person getting reimbursed and their title at work. 
Attach screenshot of receipts 
When does someone get reimbursed?

SCG: Typically will go towards your payment for the month.
Hosts/Co-hosts: Can take up to 3 weeks.

Expenses In-Kinded.description:
Contact hosts, co-hosts, and SCG personnel if applicable for in-kind.

In-kind means that an individual has essentially made a personal donation to the campaign through food, activity, ect.

The process of getting in-kind is: 

Email compliance
Title: Date of event, First and Last Name, In-Kind
Description/Body: Employer of person getting reimbursed and their title at work. 
Attach screenshot of receipts

_needs_formula.description: Automatically generated list of tasks that need to be completed for the event.

Event Staffing.description:
These are the people who will be included in the two gcal events: The setup event 30 minutes prior, and the event itself.

This will in general be at least
- the client's personal email (and spouses)
- the client's team email, eg team@simplerforstatehouse.com
- some SCG lead (often Hannah)
- someone to staff the donation table

Whenever both 1. the client is set; and 2. this field is empty; then an automation pre-populates this with the Client's Team, but besides that, this list is hand-editable.

Setup GCal Attendees.description:
- The emails of the people in the "Event Staffing" field.
- The client's "Team Email" field.
- campaigns@shipcreekgroup.com (for visibility)

If this is empty, then automation won't run, so you can use this as a psuedo on/off switch for the automation.

Main GCal Attendees.description:
- Everyone in the "Setup GCal Attendees" field.
- The emails of everyone in the "CoHosts" field.
- The frevents@shipcreekgroup.com google group
